_comment: Display metadata. steam.json is fetched separately (appid 39150) and this file only carries corrections over it.
_name: The catalog would otherwise show Steam's all-caps 'FINAL FANTASY VIII'; this is the same product, cased for a game grid.
_slug: This package is the 2013 Square Enix PC re-release, which IS Lutris entry 1670 (its Steam provider is appid 39150), so the canonical slug needs no exception. The PlayStation version that used to occupy this slug was deliberately dropped rather than shipped alongside: it cannot take PC mods, which is this package's whole purpose.

settings.help: Install the FFNx driver over the stock Steam renderer. FFNx replaces the 2013 build's D3D path with its own (Vulkan here), and it is the layer every texture pack, the external-music mods and the Hext half of the gameplay mods are written against.
settings.label: Ffnx

settings.help: Install 4x-upscaled field backgrounds -- the pre-rendered room and location art, which is what dominates the screen in any non-battle scene and which `textures` does not touch.
settings.label: Field backgrounds

settings.help: Replace the soundtrack. The 2013 release ships the 2000 PC port's audio verbatim: 91 DirectMusic .sgt sequences rendered through an 8 MB DLS instrument bank, i.e. a General-MIDI-class software synth. It is the largest fidelity gap in this package.
settings.label: Music

settings.help: Install the Ragnarok Rebalancing Mod v1.2.3 (Callisto).
settings.label: Ragnarok

settings.help: Which Ragnarok difficulty variant to install. Both ship in the same download and differ only in the six replaced `Data/lang-en` archives; "lionheart" is the harder one. Ignored unless `ragnarok` is set.
settings.label: Ragnarok mode

settings.help: Install the Tsunamods HD texture packs -- all of them:
settings.label: Textures

settings.help: Install Tsunamods Echo-S 8, a human-cast voice acting mod -- the only voiced FF8 that exists. FFNx's FF8 voice layer is complete, so this is a pure file drop.
settings.label: Voices

description: Final Fantasy VIII (2013 Square Enix PC re-release, via Proton, mod-ready)
name: Final Fantasy VIII
